title: Problems to solve objective 3 in German language
body:
Hi there,

I installed AAPS 2.82 on my phone. When I try to solve objective 3 with German language
I cannot verify my answer. Button is translated with "Schliessen" which would mean close.
And this is exactly what it does without storing my answer. If I install the app with english language
everything works fine. Might be a bug...

Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/EN/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new

comments.body: Solved: Smartphone is a Cubot King Kong 2... Use landscape mode to see the "verify"-button
